fields.climate: tropical; modified by altitude; rainy season (October to April)
fields.terrain: mostly high plateau with some hills and mountains
fields.hazards: periodic drought; tropical storms (November to April)
fields.resources: copper, cobalt, zinc, lead, coal, emeralds, gold, silver, uranium, hydropower
fields.farm: sugarcane, cassava, maize, soybeans, milk, vegetables, wheat, groundnuts, sweet potatoes, beef
fields.exports: raw copper, refined copper, gold, precious stones, electricity
fields.industries: copper mining and processing, emerald mining, construction, foodstuffs, beverages, chemicals, textiles, fertilizer, horticulture
fields.languages: Bemba 33.4%, Nyanja 14.7%, Tonga 11.4%, Lozi 5.5%, Chewa 4.5%, Nsenga 2.9%, Tumbuka 2.5%, Lunda (North Western) 1.9%, Kaonde 1.8%, Lala 1.8%, Lamba 1.8%, English (official) 1.7%, Luvale 1.5%, Mambwe…
fields.religions: Protestant 75.3%, Roman Catholic 20.2%, other 2.7% (includes Muslim, Buddhist, Hindu, and Baha'i), none 1.8%
fields.legal: mixed system of English common law and customary law
fields.military: 18-25 years of age (17 with parental consent) for voluntary military service for men and women; no conscription; initial service of 7 years followed by 5 in the Reserves
